TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Tracking stats are scoped by canonical project path, not directory basename.
SQLite open, schema, insert, and query errors are returned to callers.
Run-event reads and writes use the same canonical project identity under isolated cwd test execution.
Route-aware tracking stores adapter, route_key, and session_id and reports adapter/session aggregate savings.
Token economics include adapter_groups and session_groups so RTK coverage can be audited in gain output.
Tracking reports route_adoption_pct, routed_commands, passthrough_commands, and bounded missed_route_candidates from local SQLite data.
Local RTK adapters and system adapters record adapter-level savings through the shared tracking path.
Tracking tests serialize process environment overrides so XDG_DATA_HOME and SYNAPSE_SESSION_ID cannot cross-contaminate parallel test runs.
